info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v5-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Plans API provides access to the various subscription plans available for streaming services. Users can retrieve a comprehensive list of plans, including details such as pricing, duration, and features offered. This API is designed for developers integrating subscription functionalities into their applications, enabling them to inform users about their options. Typical consumers include app developers, digital content providers, and any platform that offers streaming services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the available subscription plans, providing necessary details that can help users select the most suitable option for their needs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving subscription plans. This body must be formatted as JSON and adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of subscription plans.
